source: x18n escapes {0} and {1} for the quotes around them. Inside {2} or {3} it escapes backslashes, that quote and line breaks. Inside a template literal it escapes backslashes, backticks and {4}. Inside a quoted attribute, such as {5}, it also writes {6} and the attribute quote as entities. Outside quotes the value goes in as is.
text: x18n 會針對包住它們的引號跳脫 {0} 和 {1}。在 {2} 或 {3} 內，會跳脫反斜線、該引號和換行。在範本字面值內，會跳脫反斜線、反引號和 {4}。在有引號的屬性內，例如 {5}，還會將 {6} 和屬性引號寫成實體。在引號之外，則原樣填入該值。
